title: MADRec: Reliable Multi-Agent Reasoning with Evidence-Grounded Debate for Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.28604v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are transforming recommender systems from conventional preference matching toward reasoning-driven and explainable decision-making. Multi-agent collaboration further advances this paradigm by distributing recommendation reasoning across specialized agents. However, existing frameworks rarely assess the reliability of intermediate reasoning during collaboration, allowing erroneous judgments to propagate across agents and ultimately degrade recommendation quality. To address this issue, we propose Multi-Agent Debate-based Recommendation (MADRec), an evidence-grounded multi-agent framework that enhances the reliability of multi-agent recommendation reasoning. MADRec consists of three coordinated modules. translated_title: MADRec：面向推荐的基于证据支撑辩论的可靠多智能体推理框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型正在将推荐系统从传统的偏好匹配转变为以推理驱动且可解释的决策模式。多智能体协作通过将推荐推理分配给专门化的智能体，进一步推动了这一范式的发展。然而，现有框架很少评估协作过程中中间推理的可靠性，导致错误判断在智能体之间传播，最终降低推荐质量。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了基于多智能体辩论的推荐系统MADRec，这是一个以证据为支撑的多智能体框架，旨在增强多智能体推荐推理的可靠性。MADRec由三个协同工作的模块组成。首先，多智能体辩论（MAD）模块使交互智能体和语义智能体能够从互补的角度分析交互信号和内容层面的语义信号，产生多样的……
tldr: 提出了一种以证据为支撑的多智能体辩论推荐框架MADRec，通过评估协作过程中中间推理的可靠性来防止错误判断在智能体间传播，从而提升多智能体推荐推理的可靠性和推荐质量。
en_tdlr: Proposes MADRec, an evidence-grounded multi-agent debate framework for recommendation that assesses the reliability of intermediate reasoning during collaboration to prevent erroneous judgments from propagating across agents, thereby enhancing the reliability of multi-agent recommendation reasoning.
